query:
SELECT
            id AS "id!: i64",
            measured_at AS "measured_at!: String",
            systolic AS "systolic!: i64",
            diastolic AS "diastolic!: i64",
            pulse AS "pulse: i64",
            memo AS "memo!: String",
            version AS "version!: i64"
        FROM bp_records
        WHERE user_id = ?
          AND (? IS NULL OR measured_at >= ?)
          AND (? IS NULL OR measured_at < ?)
        ORDER BY measured_at DESC
